profile.name: Abdul Hakim Norazman
profile.title: Senior backend and platform engineer building reliable, data-intensive systems
profile.summary: Technology consultant at Detillens, contracted to Morgan Stanley in Fund Services Technology. I specialise in Java and Spring backend systems, database and JVM performance, distributed workflow reliability and evidence-led production engineering, alongside independent products built with Python, TypeScript and PostgreSQL.

overview.label: From trading and research platforms to fund services
Production systems, independent projects and technical workshops

achievements.text: Eliminated an N+1 database lookup in a high-volume statement-generation service, reducing allocation-type lookups from 103 to 2 per request and removing about 220,000 production database round-trips per business day.
achievements.cvText: Eliminated an N+1 database lookup, reducing allocation lookups from 103 to 2 per request and removing about 220,000 production database round-trips per business day.
achievements.scope: Per request and per business day

achievements.text: Redesigned a returns-calculation data fetch to make one lean, deduplicated upstream call per fund, making the median fetch 13.9 times faster and reducing the worst production case from 31 minutes to 10 seconds.
achievements.cvText: Redesigned an upstream data fetch around one lean call per fund; production measurements were 13.9 times faster at the median and reduced the worst case from 31 minutes to 10 seconds.

achievements.text: Fixed deterministic out-of-memory failures on the largest client funds by right-sizing data fetches; UAT showed a previously failing fund completing and another running about 36 times faster with 15-57 times less allocated and promoted memory.
achievements.cvText: Fixed deterministic out-of-memory failures by right-sizing data fetches; UAT showed a failed case completing and another running about 36 times faster with 15-57 times less memory.

achievements.text: Led adoption of lean upstream-owned stored procedures using 14 of about 230 columns and fixed a join-fanout defect; UAT cut payloads by 94-95%, made one fetch up to 18 times faster and brought a previously failing 72-minute case below four minutes.
achievements.cvText: Led adoption of lean upstream-owned stored procedures and fixed a join fanout; UAT cut payloads by 94-95%, made one fetch up to 18 times faster and brought a failed 72-minute case below four minutes.

achievements.text: Deduplicated redundant upstream calls across parallel calculation branches, reducing calls per run by 64% and avoiding about 6,900 production calls per month.
achievements.cvText: Deduplicated parallel upstream calls, reducing calls per run by 64% and avoiding about 6,900 production calls per month.

achievements.text: Restructured a workflow dependency graph so one task failure invalidates two downstream tasks instead of eight, a 75% reduction validated in UAT, preventing unrelated investor-report work from waiting on the failure.
achievements.cvText: Restructured a workflow dependency graph so one failure invalidates two downstream tasks instead of eight, a 75% reduction validated in UAT.

achievements.text: Diagnosed JVM and container mis-sizing across four services, correcting a 127-CPU JVM view on 2-4-core containers, a profile-selection heap defect and manual production memory overrides through configuration as code.
achievements.cvText: Corrected JVM/container sizing across four services, including a 127-CPU JVM view on 2-4-core containers, a heap-profile defect and manual production memory overrides.

achievements.text: Added an opt-in minimal-reference-data mode to a downstream reporting API, removing all 15 downstream calls per request; validated in UAT, with production adoption owned by the calling team.
achievements.cvText: Added an opt-in API mode that removes all 15 downstream calls per request; validated in UAT, with production adoption owned by the calling team.

achievements.text: Onboarded an API gateway service to Prometheus and replaced stale, crash-looping monitors with working production telemetry, enabling fleet-wide out-of-memory and heap tracking.
achievements.cvText: Onboarded an API gateway to Prometheus and replaced stale monitors with production telemetry for fleet-wide out-of-memory and heap tracking.
achievements.scope: API gateway and service fleet telemetry

achievements.text: Eliminated a recurring production database failure caused by temporary-table name collisions under concurrency, reducing 2,285 incidents across 84% of business days to zero after release, confirmed in two independent log sources.
achievements.cvText: Eliminated a concurrency-related production database failure, reducing 2,285 recurring incidents across 84% of business days to zero after release.

achievements.text: Parallelised a three-way returns calculation, making that production step 54% faster across all funds and 50% faster on the largest fund.
achievements.cvText: Parallelised a three-way returns calculation, making that production step 54% faster across all funds and 50% faster on the largest fund.

achievements.text: Fixed connection leaks behind a production database-pool exhaustion incident and added pool-usage gauges; a load test drove the pool to its 20-connection limit, completed all 204 requests and returned usage to zero within about 30 seconds ahead of production release.
achievements.cvText: Fixed connection leaks behind a production pool-exhaustion incident and added gauges; a pre-release load test completed all 204 requests at the 20-connection limit and returned usage to zero.

achievements.text: Removed duplicate lookups from a returns-initialisation path, making that phase 27% faster and reducing a large-fund generation run by about 15%; measured in UAT and not yet in production.
achievements.cvText: Removed duplicate returns-initialisation lookups, making the phase 27% faster and one large-fund UAT run about 15% faster; not yet in production.
achievements.scope: Returns-initialisation phase and one large-fund UAT run
